name: Standard Module Template
description: Comprehensive reference module template with all framework capabilities.
help_text: Configure the Target DUT Control Port in the top Hardware Connection toolbar. Configure the target voltage and allowed deviation tolerance, then execute in mock simulation or real hardware mode.

criteria_help.max_deviation_pct: Allowable deviation threshold from target voltage.
criteria_help.enable_calibration: Enable software offset calibration before measuring.
criteria_help.calibration_offset_mv: Offset added to raw ADC measurement.
